resources.string: Bubble for dictating and inserting text in any app

sayEmber uses this service to show the dictation bubble and to insert your dictation into the field you\'re writing in. For that, it reads which app is open and whether a text field is selected (to show or hide the bubble), where the keyboard is (to keep the bubble clear of the keys), and, only while inserting a dictation, the text already in that field, so the new words fit in at the cursor. Password fields are never read. If a field doesn\'t accept the dictation directly, the service pastes it from the clipboard. Nothing it reads is sent anywhere. Which apps you dictated in is kept on this phone, for your statistics and your history. Right after you turn on something in Android\'s settings that sayEmber sent you to (this service, or unrestricted battery use), the service brings sayEmber back to the front. Beyond that, it never taps, swipes or acts for you.
